people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
translations.bsb: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
translations.asv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messiah cometh (he that is called Christ): when he is come, he will declare unto us all things.
